metric: Pedestrian ratio NS/OU by unit

metric: Jitter-robust moving pedestrian path (km)
method: 1 s decimated steps >= 0.5 m, 29 Oct 07:12-08:35, common region (2,780 m2)
uncertainty: Rule-dependent; Ouster could include merged/fragment tracks
interpretation: Ouster records ~1.5x more moving-pedestrian movement in the same area

metric: Cyclist observations confirmed by the other sensor
Jitter-robust moving cyclist path (km): Cyclist + NS Motorcycle / Cyclist label only

uncertainty: 0.62x if Ouster UNKNOWN movement is added
interpretation: Ouster records more VRU movement (0.83x)

metric: Vehicle label agreement given a match
interpretation: Both agree on vehicle vs not-vehicle

limitations: Video decided only 1 of 17 conflict tiles (NS right)

metric: Same object reported as two VRU classes (persistent pairs >= 10 frames)
interpretation: Newsense double-counts VRUs (Cyclist+Pedestrian etc.)

metric: Unclassified objects
ouster: 10.4 % UNKNOWN (region); 73 % of PED tracks start as UNKNOWN
interpretation: Ouster admits uncertainty; Newsense forces a class

metric: Identifier reused for a different object / instant swap (83 min)
method: Full own coverage, id event classification (NS: 636 after > 60 s; 3 after 15-58 s, all with class change)
interpretation: Newsense ids are not unique object keys

metric: Same id re-attached after a 5-30 s loss (Ouster re-find flag)
newsense: 0 (the 2 events of this length are reused ids)
method: As above; vendor refind_time field checked in the final audit
limitations: Count depends on the 5 s threshold; Ouster also bridges ~1,400 shorter 1-5 s gaps
interpretation: Ouster re-attaches ids after short losses; same physical object not verified

metric: Moving-track breaks with nearby continuation per robust km (PED / CYC incl. NS Motorcycle / VEH, T = 2 s)
method: Stitching analysis (not applied); same classes in links and km (CORR-02); Cyclist label only 33.9 vs 9.1
uncertainty: T = 1-3 s same ranking; Ouster UNKNOWN attribution: PED 1.2-1.9x, VEH 2.0-3.4x
limitations: Dense groups can create spurious links
interpretation: Newsense fragments moving tracks more often in every group (T = 2 s: PED 1.6x, CYC 3.1-3.7x, VEH 3.4x; size definition-dependent)

metric: Median pedestrian track duration in region (s)
